info.description: Worldwide live mobility near a coordinate.

get.summary: Read the canonical ROOTE API release changelog
get.description: Public, unmetered and provider-independent release history. Supports ETag conditional requests and a bounded cache policy.

entries.description: Canonical history ordered by published_at descending, then stable id.

304.description: The canonical changelog has not changed.

get.description: Global in-process orchestrator. With no filters it queries mobility, transit and services. families is authoritative; otherwise modes and types infer eligible families. One credit is settled for each successful, empty or genuinely partial family; a total technical family failure is refunded.

get.summary: Public ranking of useful city searches
get.description: Aggregated, privacy-safe usage by stable city identifier. No coordinates, users, projects, tokens or event rows are exposed.
Resolves address-like queries into up to five candidates in Google ranking order. The API does not choose a conversational answer.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Compatibility API token; prefer Authorization Bearer.

200.description: Up to five ordered geographic candidates. The first result is the provider's highest-ranked candidate, not a guaranteed unique match. No results returns HTTP 200 and an empty array.

results.description: Geographic candidates in provider relevance order.

match_quality.description: Provider-reported geocoding precision when available; not a ROOTE confidence score.

get.description: Returns a compact service result with per-type counts. Parking and charging reuse the same Google adapter as their specialized endpoints; lockers use the public, non-guaranteed InPost Geowidget source behind a defensive adapter. Provider failures produce partial coverage; provider orchestration and counters are returned only when debug=true.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Requested metres; values above 10000 are clamped to 10000

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Requested aggregate count; values above 200 are clamped to 200. Google returns at most 20 items for each Google-backed category; InPost returns at most 100.

get.summary: Get upcoming departures for a transport station
get.description: Requires data:read. Resolves the canonical ROOTE station ID to active provider references server-side, executes a bounded plan over established boarding relations and reconciles only proven passage occurrences. expected_at is the selected display time; coherence.timing separates nullable scheduled and predicted times and identifies stale or unknown freshness fallbacks. An all-provider failure has status error, not empty. Departure IDs no longer use display labels; consumers must treat previous IDs as unverified historical keys.

parameters.name: projection
parameters.description: Include shared transport presentation from the same acquired departures and stored structures

parameters.name: line
parameters.description: Optional canonical line number or name

get.summary: Calculate an A-to-B public transport journey
get.description: Requires journey:read. Legacy-compatible A-to-B form of Journey Contract 1.0.0. Provider fallback is sequential by default; compare is explicit. scheduled_at remains distinct from realtime estimated_at.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Requested alternatives; capability limits and a maximum of 10 apply

parameters.description: Normal primary selection, controlled fallback, or explicit comparison

get.description: Returns canonical ROOTE mobility entities. High-confidence observations of the same physical station are resolved and merged before counts, pagination and billing. Provider identity, provenance, cache, usage, protection and orchestration diagnostics are included only when debug=true. A valid token with data:read is required. Radius is capped at 400 metres.
